title: Criteria for Setting-up of Public Library
what_it_is: Criteria for Setting-up of Public Library

sections.label: Library location planning criteria
sections.summary: NLB plans library locations using URA's masterplan, requiring a planning area population of at least 150,000 residents and convenient locations near town centres, malls, MRT stations and bus interchanges.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Library locations are planned with reference to the Urban Redevelopment Authority's (URA's) land use masterplan.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: NLB seeks to locate in a planning area where the population size has a minimum threshold of 150,000 residents.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: In addition, NLB looks for convenient locations, either within or near town centres, or in shopping malls with easy access to the Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) stations and bus interchanges.

sections.label: Reading corners and mobile services
sections.summary: Over 120 reading corners in community spaces and preschools complement the 26 public libraries, while Project Deliver Me and MOLLY buses bring library content and services to the underserved.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: The 26 public libraries are complemented by over 120 reading corners in community spaces and preschools across the island.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Project Deliver Me and the Mobile Library (MOLLY) buses are two further initiatives through which NLB brings library content and services to the underserved.

sections.label: Library services and digital collection
sections.summary: The services are offered at Orchard, Sembawang and Pasir Ris libraries, with plans to expand to all branches by 2017, and NLB offers over four million e-books via its website or mobile app.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: They are now offered at three libraries – Orchard, Sembawang and Pasir Ris.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: And, Madam, there are plans to expand this to all branches by 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Page: 8 NLB also offers digital library services.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: It currently offers a collection of over four million e-books which are easily accessible through its website or the NLB mobile app.

sections.label: No interim or temporary libraries
sections.summary: The answer to the first question is that interim or temporary libraries will not be set up.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: To the first question, unfortunately, the answer is that interim or temporary libraries will not be set up.
